newsitem.title: GERMANY: Danzas wins BASF outsourcing deal.
newsitem.headline: Danzas wins BASF outsourcing deal.

text.p: International freight forwarder Danzas AG said it has won an outsourcing contract worth several million marks from BASF Schwarzheide GmbH.
The forwarder's Berlin branch will take over logistics and export organisation for two plants producing industrial granules under a three-year contract, a company statement said.
Karola Kelle, BASF Schwarzheide logistics manager, said the company decided to outsource to gain improved transport service and more viable operations.
Danzas said it already ran the company's plastics complex under a separate logistics contract. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
